items.reply: I change my classification to FP. The new fetch has no application timeout and Zoom awaits it, but the previous provider-refresh fetch also lacked one; the sync branch substitutes an explicitly configured endpoint. These facts establish a dependency on the endpoint’s response, not indefinite blocking or worker exhaustion. Without a demonstrated timeout-contract violation or failure mechanism beyond hypothetical endpoint unresponsiveness, adding an AbortController is a hardening suggestion.
